content_html:
Getting to Machu Picchu is an essential part of the experience. Before marveling at the sacred city, there is a key decision to make: should you travel by local train or tourist train?
Both take you to the same destination, but the experience is very different. Here we explain everything so you can choose the option that best suits your trip.

Local Train
The most economical and authentic option

The local train is mainly used by locals and some adventurous travelers.

Main features:

Economical fare

Shared travel with local people

⏱ Limited and less flexible schedules

Does not include tourist services

Important:
Access to the local train is often restricted for foreign tourists and requires more organization, patience, and time.

Ideal for:
Travelers on a tight budget, backpackers, and those looking for a more local and basic experience.

Tourist Train
Comfort, scenery, and experience

The tourist train is the most popular option for domestic and international travelers seeking comfort and tranquility.

Main features:

Panoramic windows to enjoy the Sacred Valley

Comfortable seats and ample space

Atmosphere and tourist services

⏰ Multiple schedules and greater punctuality

The journey becomes part of the trip, with spectacular views of rivers, mountains, and Andean landscapes.
Ideal for:
Travelers on a tight budget, backpackers, and those looking for a more local and basic experience.

Tourist Train
Comfort, scenery, and experience

The tourist train is the most popular option for domestic and international travelers seeking comfort and tranquility.

Main features:

Panoramic windows to enjoy the Sacred Valley

Comfortable seats and ample space

Atmosphere and tourist services

⏰ Multiple schedules and greater punctuality

The journey becomes part of the trip, with spectacular views of rivers, mountains, and Andean landscapes.

Ideal for:
Families, couples, international travelers, and those who want a safe, organized, and smooth experience.

Quick comparison
Feature Local Train Tourist Train
Price Economical Medium-high
Comfort Basic High
Services Not included Included
Flexibility Limited High
Experience Local Tourist and panoramic
Which one should you choose?

The choice depends on:

your budget

the time you have available

the level of comfort you want

whether it’s your first time in Machu Picchu

General recommendation:
If you’re traveling from abroad or it’s your first visit, the tourist train is the best option for enjoying the journey without any worries.
